log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought:
Lead: 47% BRING: dragapult, 20% BRING: whimsicott, 11% BRING: palafin
Pick 2: 31% BRING: chandelure, 20% BRING: whimsicott, 19% BRING: gholdengo
Pick 3: 32% BRING: whimsicott, 26% BRING: palafin, 25% BRING: toxapex

Plan: Lead Incineroar for Intimidate and Fake Out support. Kingambit is the main physical threat, and Garchomp is fast enough to pressure Palafin, Chandelure and Whimsicott. Opponent threats: Dragapult (very fast, likely Infiltrator or Clear Body), Gholdengo, Chandelure (special), Toxapex (wall, poison), Palafin (Hero form Mega-like boost), Whimsicott (Prankster status). Save Incineroar's Parting Shot for Chandelure or Gholdengo.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I need to pick 3 from my team against their Gholdengo, Palafin, Dragapult, Toxapex, Chandelure, Whimsicott lineup — weighing Incineroar's intimidate and fake out utility against Kingambit, Gholdengo, Garchomp, Azumarill, and Corviknight for matchup coverage.

Corviknight resists Dragapult's dragon STAB with its Steel typing but takes fire neutrally from Chandelure, while Garchomp also handles Dragapult well despite the shared weakness. I'll settle on Incineroar, Kingambit, and Garchomp as my lead three.

decisions.thought: 79% MOVE: dragonpulse, 8% SWITCH: chandelure, 7% SWITCH: whimsicott

Opponent lead Dragapult (Dragon/Ghost) is likely faster than my whole team. Fake Out can't hit it (Ghost is immune to Normal). Darkest Lariat is super effective and ignores its Atk drop, so I'm attacking with it. Plan: pressure Dragapult with Lariat, then bring in Kingambit or Garchomp as needed. Save Parting Shot for Chandelure or Gholdengo. Watch for Infiltrator or Clear Body, and for Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocking status moves.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Fake Out won't hit Dragapult since it's Ghost-type and immune to Normal moves, but Darkest Lariat is Dark-type and would be super effective against Dragapult's Dragon typing.

Since Dragapult likely outspeeds Incineroar, it'll attack first, but Darkest Lariat ignores stat stage changes so the super-effective hit should still land hard, taking roughly half its HP. I'll go with Darkest Lariat here rather than switching with Parting Shot.

decisions.thought: 44% MOVE: willowisp [MEGA], 20% MOVE: fireblast [MEGA], 12% MOVE: calmmind [MEGA]

Opponent lost Dragapult to Lariat. Chandelure (Ghost/Fire, high SpA) is now in; Gholdengo, Palafin, Toxapex and Whimsicott remain, one of them still to come. Chandelure likely outspeeds Incineroar and may hit hard first. Darkest Lariat is super effective on Chandelure and likely KOs it. If it survives, Parting Shot or a switch to Kingambit (resists Ghost, takes 2x from Fire) is the fallback. Keep Garchomp for Palafin, Whimsicott or Toxapex.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Chandelure's Ghost/Fire typing means Darkest Lariat hits it super effectively, but Chandelure's speed likely lets it move first and blast Incineroar with Fire/Shadow Ball before taking that hit, so the outcome comes down to whether Incineroar's Darkest Lariat can actually KO through Chandelure's HP pool.

Considering a swap to Kingambit instead: its Dark/Steel typing resists Chandelure's Ghost attacks but is weak to Fire moves, so Chandelure's Fire-type coverage could still punish it despite Kingambit's solid special defense.

Weighing that against just firing off Darkest Lariat with Incineroar right now, since it's taking a hit regardless — the super-effective damage against Chandelure seems like the more reliable play, roughly estimating it chunks a significant portion of its health even without a guaranteed KO.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: 75% MOVE: dazzlinggleam, 15% MOVE: leechseed, 9% MOVE: grassyterrain

Whimsicott (Grass/Fairy) is active. Its ability is unknown (Prankster, Infiltrator or Chlorophyll), and it likely has Moonblast, which is super effective on my Dark/Fire Incineroar. Flare Blitz is 2x on Whimsicott, so it is the best attack. Garchomp (speed 169) can revenge-kill later. Kingambit resists Dark/Fairy-type hits poorly, so keep Parting Shot for a Gholdengo or Palafin switch-in. Remaining opponent threats: Gholdengo, Palafin, Toxapex.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Whimsicott is Grass/Fairy against Incineroar at 138/202, so Flare Blitz hits hard but Darkest Lariat is resisted by the Fairy typing. I'm considering Whimsicott's Prankster options—Tailwind, Encore, or Moonblast—since Moonblast would hit Incineroar's Dark/Fire typing neutrally.

decisions.thought: 92% MOVE: dazzlinggleam, 5% MOVE: leechseed, 2% MOVE: grassyterrain

Whimsicott is at 1% but outspeeds Incineroar, so attacking now risks losing Incineroar (91 HP) to a Dazzling Gleam first. Switching to Kingambit (neutral to Fairy, 207 HP) absorbs that hit safely. Next turn Kingambit can finish Whimsicott. Remaining opponent threats: Gholdengo, Palafin, Toxapex. Save Parting Shot for a Gholdengo or Palafin switch-in, and keep Garchomp for Palafin or Toxapex.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Whimsicott at 1% HP outspeeds Incineroar, so it moves first and could hit with Dazzling Gleam for likely significant damage given its boosted SpA against Incineroar's SpD, though Incineroar should still survive at 91 HP.

Fake Out isn't actually a legal option here since Incineroar already took its first turn out, so the real choices for Incineroar come down to Flare Blitz, Darkest Lariat, Parting Shot, or switching out.

Since Incineroar is Dark-type, it's immune to Prankster-boosted status moves like Taunt, so Whimsicott's only real threat is Dazzling Gleam. Parting Shot would let me pivot to Kingambit, which takes Fairy damage at roughly neutral since its Steel typing offsets Fairy's advantage against Dark—but the simplest path is just attacking with Flare Blitz or Darkest Lariat to kill Whimsicott, keeping in mind it still moves first.

Switching takes priority over moves, so if I bring in Kingambit or Garchomp instead, Whimsicott's attack would hit the newly switched-in mon rather than the one on the field now. Kingambit would take roughly neutral damage from Dazzling Gleam given its typing and 207 HP, so it's safe, and Whimsicott would be left at 1% after using Parting Shot.

decisions.thought: 76% MOVE: dazzlinggleam, 11% MOVE: leechseed, 11% MOVE: grassyterrain

Whimsicott is at 1% and faster than Kingambit, but Sucker Punch has +1 priority and works because Whimsicott is attacking. Expect Dazzling Gleam or a status move first, but Kingambit should survive at 164 HP. Afterwards the field is Gholdengo, Palafin and Toxapex. Save Parting Shot for a switch-in, keep Garchomp for Palafin or Toxapex, and watch for Gholdengo's Make It Rain or Shadow Ball. Incineroar is at 91 HP and can be healed by Sitrus Berry only if it has one, which it does not now.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Whimsicott is at 1% HP but moves first since Kingambit's base speed is slower, so its Dazzling Gleam isn't priority but still lands before Kingambit can act—and since Kingambit is Dark/Steel, it's weak to Fairy and could take heavy damage.

Alternatively, switching in Garchomp could be strong: Dragon-type moves are immune against Fairy, but Earthquake is only resisted (0.5x), while Stone Edge hits for 2x against Grass/Fairy—and Garchomp's speed should outpace Whimsicott anyway.

If Kingambit stays in instead, Whimsicott's Dazzling Gleam likely does moderate but non-lethal damage given Kingambit's solid special defense, letting Kingambit retaliate with Iron Head (super effective, with flinch chance) to finish Whimsicott off.
